title: Writing / Style / Percentages
slide_intent: Use a compact percentage form so proportions remain easy to spot in a line of copy.
strategic_value: One standard representation can help Duolingo avoid competing spellings for the same quantity.
demonstration: The preferred numeric percentage is compared with percent written as one word and two words.
practical_value: Use the percent symbol with the numeric value.

content_islands.name: Guidance column
content_islands.spec: Place the topic heading, its parent label and the written convention in the narrow left column.

content_islands.name: Worked examples
content_islands.spec: Place the worked copy in the pale right panel, keeping preference labels and green checks with their examples.

reference_purposes.Application: The comparison shows 95% against two written-out alternatives.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Use the % symbol rather than spelling out percent.
